text.description: Text body. Empty for attachment-only or deleted messages.

mentions.description: Users directly mentioned in the message.

latestReactions.description: Most recent reactions per type. Fetch the full list on demand.

pinned.description: True when the message is currently pinned at channel scope.

system.description: True when the message is system-generated.

timelineSeq.description: Monotonic per-channel sequence covering every channel mutation. Used to page the channel timeline.

visibleSeq.description: Monotonic per-channel sequence covering only visible messages. Used for unread counts and read pointers.

channelVersion.description: Channel version. Increments on every channel mutation.

messageVersion.description: Message version. Increments on every message mutation.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision (e.g. `2026-05-07T05:35:00.000Z`).

editedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent edit.

event.description: System event identifier for client rendering.

width.description: Image or video width in pixels.

channelId.description: Direct-channel ids are the 8-4-4-4-8 slices of the two member ids. An `a_` member id puts `_` in a slice, so the pattern allows it.

MessageMessagingStatus.description: The delivery state of a message an agent sent over a customer messaging channel (see MessagingChannel), the same four states as WhatsApp. TRYING, SENT and ERROR are written by kite around the send; DELIVERED and a late ERROR arrive through the channel's status stream event (MESSENGER.STATUS today). A READ report is recorded as DELIVERED, as the WhatsApp producer does one hop earlier.

MessagingChannel.description: A customer messaging channel that reaches x-bees through classound and is not SMS or WhatsApp. One discriminator instead of a boolean per channel, so a new channel adds a member here and not a set of channel fields. RCS is listed but not accepted yet: whether an RCS conversation is a telephony channel is still open, so conversations refuses it until its ticket decides.
